lines.text: I love a good meal! What about you?
Have you seen Mica? I want to tease her a bit, but I can't seem to find her.
Wanna see some firecrackers? I'll show you something really cool!
Are you over your cold? Don't get sick. Let's get something delicious to eat!
Let's eat something delicious together.
Can you draw a heart on my palm?

Huh? Where did you go? 
You were playing and ran away?
Mister, I'm not joking anymore. Please come back soon.
Would you like to come to the toy store? They've got all sorts of neat stuff there!
Buy me something yummy! Old-Timer!
Who should I prank today?
Let's go find something delicious, Old-Timer!
Thanks.
Is something troubling you, Old-Timer!
Heh heh, now I can take my pranks to the next level!
Is this for me? Really?
You know, you're the first person who's ever given me a present!
I LOVE IT!
I love anyone who brings me lots of yummy goodies I can eat!
How about we share some heart-shaped Splendamin?
Hey, did you know? I think you're just the coolest!
Will you buy me some snacks on the way?
What are we going to play?
Are you sending me there?
Eek! Something scary is coming!
If I defeat all the baddies, can we eat something yummy?
Firecrackers incoming!
Wowee, they sure look scary!
This is gonna be a big one.
Gotta reload!
Just a little longer...
Old-Timer!
The bigger the firecracker, the better!
I'm going to set off all the firecrackers!
I got it!
I didn't hurt you, did I?
KO!
Yes!
Argh!
Eeep!
If I had known this would happen, I'd have filled up on some more good food beforehand...
The bigger the boom, the bigger the win!
